lines.en: I walk step by step. Upright.

lines.zh: 我身上的源石长成了荆棘。
lines.en: The originium grew into thorns on me.
I walk straight at my target.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很整齐，像仪仗。
lines.en: Even steps. Like a procession.
Grey marks follow my feet.

lines.zh: 我身上的源石长成荆棘，挡不住路。
lines.en: The originium on me grows like thorns, but never blocks my way.
Head up. I don't watch the ground.

lines.zh: 晶体在我肩上排成一列。
lines.en: Crystals in a row on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我经过时，空气里有矿石的响。
lines.en: As I pass, ore dust whispers.
I walk toward the crowd.
Heavy armor. Silent steps.

lines.zh: 我的影子笔直，跟我一样。
lines.en: My shadow is straight. Like me.
I stand like a monument.

lines.zh: 我的手垂着，指节嵌着晶。
lines.en: My hands hang. Crystal in the knuckles.

lines.zh: 我在等指示，或者等目标。
lines.en: Waiting for an order. Or a target.
The originium moves slowly inside.
The originium on me grows slowly.
I look up. Grey sky. Good.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，时间对我没意义。
lines.en: I don't blink. Time means little.
Counting the life nearby.

lines.zh: 我身上的晶体在互相磨。
lines.en: My crystals grind against each other.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，风绕着我走。
lines.en: Still. The wind goes around me.
You've been marked by me.
This look is an assessment.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地看着你喘。
lines.en: I watch you breathe, without moving.

lines.zh: 你身上没有源石，不完整。
lines.en: No originium on you. Incomplete.

lines.zh: 源石在血里，我一听就知道。
lines.en: Originium in the blood—I hear it at once.
I tilt my head. Crystals clink.

lines.zh: 你在退，你的选择是对的。
lines.en: You're retreating. Correct choice.
This scene means little.
Do you want to be chosen by the Originium?
I set my gaze on you.
A crystal broke.
My posture is unchanged.
You didn't break this layer.
I step back, then raise my hand again.

lines.zh: 这一下，会延长你的时间。
lines.en: That just lengthens this.
A layer of ash fell off me.
I turn my head. Crystals clink.

lines.zh: 我不会因为疼而改变路线。
lines.en: Pain won't change my route.
A crystal shattered; I am still here.
Continue. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你递来的东西，我不需要。
lines.en: What you offer. Unneeded.
Ore is part of my body.
Not worth stopping for.
Hold it higher. I can't make it out.
I wasn't raised on handouts.
Keep it.
The vein here is better than that.
Your arm must be tired.
Faint smell. Meaningless.

lines.zh: 我只会向前，不会绕过你。
lines.en: I only go forward. Not around.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的位置，正好是晶体。
lines.en: You hit a crystal, of all places.
I didn't yield an inch.
Touch my shoulder. Your hand goes numb.
Half a block. A courtesy.
You hit me and bounce back half a step.
Don't press. The originium transfers.
Impacts don't stop me.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，本来就该让开。
lines.en: That spot was always mine to pass.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的肩膀要疼很久。
lines.en: Your shoulder will ache a while.
Still the same straight line.
My path excludes that.

lines.zh: 源石会传下去，但不需要伴。
lines.en: The ore passes on. Companions aren't needed.

lines.zh: 你站远些，我的晶体锋利。
lines.en: Stand back. My crystals are sharp.
I don't answer such requests.
My place is in the line.
Take your hand off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我连自己的名字都不常用。
lines.en: I rarely use even my own name.
Back away. That's the last word.
All my life I go forward.
You're not qualified for that.
I pick it up and look once.
Useless. I keep it.
This carries the vein's smell.

lines.zh: 我举到眼前，晶体挡住了。
lines.en: Up to my eye. A crystal blocks it.
Into a gap in my armor.
Too light to record.
There's more on the ground.

lines.zh: 你松手的东西，我替你保管。
lines.en: Whatever you let fall, I will keep safe for you.
My fingers are stiff. Weak grip.
This one's good. Keep it.
You've entered range.
Locking on. Hold still.
Your warmth. I see it.
Only you in this direction.
My fingers are already pointed at you.
I judge you an obstacle.
The procession needs you to clear.

lines.zh: 源石在我体内结成了晶。
lines.en: Originium crystallized inside me.
Seeing you is already enough.

lines.zh: 你动了一下，源石的光芒就够了。
lines.en: You moved once; the Originium glow suffices.
I've started moving.
I'm going through where you stand.
Every crystal faces you.
Position recorded.
I give only one warning.
The warning period is over.
I walk straight in.
You sidestep. My heading doesn't.

lines.zh: 我在你前面就停下，不加速。
lines.en: I stop before you. No acceleration.
Your weapon won't cut crystal.
The light on me grows stronger.
The wall is behind you, and I am in front.

lines.zh: 我没有情绪，所以不会失误。
lines.en: No emotion. So no mistakes.
You are panting in the dark; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 这一片地面在我的路线上。
lines.en: This ground is on my path.
Listen. The crystals are resonating.
I raise my hand. Knuckles crack.
You turned. I saw.
Three steps between us.
Two steps. Very close.
Still backing. Nowhere to go.
I've walked the distance.

lines.zh: 现在，我的视线在你身上。
lines.en: Now my gaze is on you.
You won't get another chance.
My arm's speed doesn't change.
This ends here.
One hand comes down.

lines.zh: 晶体的边缘划开你的肩膀。
lines.en: A crystal edge opens your shoulder.
Originium grows in my bones.
You hit the wall behind you.
I take your wrist and twist.

lines.zh: 你的盾接住了，胳膊没接住。
lines.en: Your shield caught it; your arm did not.
Heavy fist. Slow.

lines.zh: 晶体从我手臂上长出来。
lines.en: Crystal grows out of my arm.
I pin you. You won't roll.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，晶体划了过去。
lines.en: You guarded. The crystal went through.
I'm not striking. Just pressing.
You're coughing. Ash in your lungs.
I step back and straighten.
That one you brought on yourself.
Still moving. I press again.
You're down. Not dead.
My foot lifts. Don't watch.
One step forward. Flatten.

lines.zh: 地面有个坑，是你留下的。
lines.en: There's a crater. That was you.
I keep walking forward.
I'm raised up out of the vein.

lines.zh: 我站直了，晶体整排亮起。
lines.en: I straighten. A row of crystals lights.

lines.zh: 这里的灰先落定，我才动。
lines.en: The ash settled first. Then I moved.

lines.zh: 我像一根柱子，插在土里。
lines.en: Like a pillar sunk into the soil.

lines.zh: 源石在我体内排列成列。
lines.en: The originium lines up inside me.
When I appeared, everything quieted.

lines.zh: 我不需要看就知道方向。
lines.en: I know the direction without looking.

lines.zh: 这一片，从今天开始被巡。
lines.en: This area is patrolled from today.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，从灰里出来。
lines.en: Step by step, out of the ash.

lines.zh: 晶体第一次互相碰撞，响。
lines.en: First clink of crystals.
One sweep of my gaze.
I raise a hand. The forward gesture.
Fire blackened a crystal's face.
I landed and my knee buckled once.
Water inside the armor. Heavy.
The blast pushed me half a step.

lines.zh: 源石在我甲片下长，越扎越深。
lines.en: Originium grows under my plates, deeper each time.

lines.zh: 这种力量不在我的认知里。
lines.en: That power is outside what I know.
Ore running low. My crystals dim.

lines.zh: 雷打在甲上，全身一瞬失控。
lines.en: Lightning on the armor. One instant of no control.
Falling. Still upright.
